_common.notes: All Make*Value funcs switch on the JSON type (String=0, Number=1, Object=2, Array=3, Boolean=4, Null=5). Every error string gets ' [@<json path>]' appended. A Null value (JSON null) in float/bool/string/stringlist returns NO value and NO error (silent; the module gets a null value). Literal kinds go through MakeMutator: string->StringLiteral, number->FloatLiteral, bool->BooleanLiteral, object->'Mutate'/'Var', array->FlatteningStringList (stringlist base only; any other base -> 'Invalid Value/Mutate'). A literal of the wrong class -> 'Mutate Type Error Expected "{base}" Found "{class}"' (class display names, e.g. CD2_Float_Mutator / StringLiteral). Implicit per-player arrays exist ONLY at the value level (MakeFloatValue/MakeBooleanValue/MakeStringValue/MakeFloatArrayValue); a float param nested inside a mutator goes through MakeMutator, where an array is 'Invalid Value/Mutate'. String comparisons on keys render as ==/!= in the decompile = KismetStringLibrary StriStri (case-insensitive) and maps/sets are TMap<FString>/TSet<FString> (case-insensitive), so 'Mutate' names and param keys are case-insensitive [inferred from UE FString semantics].

mutate_object.notes: GetMutatorClass: 'Mutate' is checked first (wins over 'Var'). Mutate value not a string -> 'Mutate value must be a String name.'; unknown name -> 'Unrecognized Mutate {name}.'; object with neither Mutate nor Var -> "Expected Mutator Object, but no 'Mutate' field found.". Names come from the asset registry: every CD2_Mutator subclass asset under /Game/_AssemblyStorm/CustomDifficulty2/Mutators (recursive), keyed by asset name. If the class is a CD2_Select_Mutator child it goes through MakeSelectorMutator (polymorphic); otherwise it must be a child of the base type the context wants, except a String mutator is accepted where a StringList is wanted (wrapped as a 1-element list by CD2_StringList_StringWrapper). Key 'Mutate' itself is skipped by every ConfigureMutator.

var.notes: Object without 'Mutate' but with 'Var' -> CD2_{Float,Boolean,String,StringList}_Variable_Mutator picked by the context's base type (other base -> 'Unsupported Variable Type.'). Only the key 'Var' is allowed (' No parameters are supported'); Var must be a string ('Var must be String'); empty -> '!! VAR MISSING !!'. Reads the CD2_VariableMonitor; a missing variable at evaluation logs "Missing Variable '{v}'" and yields 0/false/''/[] . StringList var falls back to a String var wrapped as [s]. Becomes ready only once the variable is published (OnVariableReady; name matched case-SENSITIVELY there). Update interval 0.5 s. NOTE: Var is NOT accepted directly by MakeRandIntervalsValue (an object without 'Mutate' is read as a range).

accepts: array -> implicit per-player-count (CD2_Implicit_Player_Count), each element a float value/mutator
float.notes: Verified FORMAT.md. string/bool -> 'Mutate Type Error Expected "CD2_Float_Mutator" Found "StringLiteral"' etc. null -> silent no value. BUG: errors from the implicit per-player array branch are collected into a local list and dropped, then the func returns with no Value and no Errors (a bad element in a top-level float array fails silently).

per_player_array.notes: CD2_Implicit_Player_Count (and ByPlayerCount): picks element index = playerCount-1, clamped to [0, len-1] (last element repeats for more players). playerCount = number of player characters if there is at least one AND mission time > 30 s, else the length of the network-sorted player-state array. Re-evaluated at least every 2 s. Elements go through MakeMutator with the context's base type (so a nested array inside is NOT per-player again). Waits for the PLS before ready. Element errors are reported (for bool/string/floatarray contexts).

accepts: array -> implicit per-player-count of bool values
bool.notes: string/number -> Mutate Type Error (Expected "CD2_Boolean_Mutator"). null -> silent no value. Fallback error text 'Expected Boolean Value Got {class}'.

accepts: array -> implicit per-player-count of string values
string.notes: number/bool -> Mutate Type Error (Expected "CD2_String_Mutator"). null -> silent no value. Fallback error 'Expected String Value Got {class}'.

stringlist.notes: A bare string at value level -> 'Expected List of Strings, Got String'. number/bool -> Mutate Type Error (Expected "CD2_StringList_Mutator"). null -> silent no value. Array items: a JSON string is taken literally; anything else goes through MakeMutator(StringList): a nested array is flattened in, an object is a Mutate/Var (string mutators wrapped as 1 element), number/bool -> type error. NO per-player arrays for stringlist (an array is always a list). Fallback error 'Expected StringList Value Got {class}'.

accepts: number / string / object -> single-element array [MakeMutator float]
array with <= 4 elements -> one float value/mutator per element
array with > 4 elements -> ONE implicit per-player-count float (array of length 1)
floatarray.notes: Bool or null -> 'Value Must be an Array of Floats or a single float'. An element (or the single value) that is not a float -> same message, or the MakeMutator type error. Unclear intent but literal code: the >4 rule means a 5+ element array is read as per-player, not as a 5-float array.

randinterval.notes: Object without 'Mutate' is a range: 'Max' checked first ('Range Must Specify 'Max''), then 'Min' ('Range Must Specify 'Min''); 'Weight' optional, default 1 (FloatLiteral 1.0). Other keys in a range are ignored (no error). Min/Max/Weight each go through MakeMutator(float) so they may be literals, Mutate or Var objects (no per-player arrays). In the array form every element must be an object ('Expected Random Range'), bare numbers are not accepted; an element with 'Mutate' is still read as a range. A {"Var":...} object at top level is read as a range (error Max missing). string -> Mutate Type Error; bool/null -> 'Value Must be an RandInterval, Range or Float'.

selector.notes: MakeSelectorMutator: any Mutate whose class is a CD2_Select_Mutator child (Select, SelectFromArray, If, IfFloat, ByPlayerCount, RandomChoice, RandomChoicePerMission, ByBiome, ByMissionType, ByDNA, ByDDStage, BySecondary, ByMissionComplexity, ByMissionDuration, By*Phase, IfOnSpaceRig, and other readers' ByResuppliesCalled, Sequence, EnemyCooldown) is built with OptionsBaseClass = the context's base type, so every option is parsed with MakeMutator(<context type>) and the result is wrapped in CD2_{Float,Boolean,String,StringList}_Selector. So a Select-family mutator returns float, bool, string or stringlist depending on where it is used; all options must be that type. At evaluation the selector calls Select(); if the chosen option is null (no match, no Default) the selector leaves its output unset (0/false/''/[]). Base outside those four -> '!Internal Error! Unsupported Base Class For Selector'. RequiresAuthority/update interval forward to the select mutator.

Values.notes: each element appended to the operand list; not an array -> error text is just 'Values [@path]'

extra.notes: ANY other key (any name) is one more operand; keys and Values combine. At least one operand: 'At least one Operand required'
any other key is an operand (see Add)
any other key is an operand (see Add)
any other key is an operand (see Add)

Subtract.notes: A - B. Other key -> 'Unexpected field "{field}", Use 'A' and 'B''.

Value.notes: missing Value is not an error; evaluates as 0

Clamp.notes: max(Min, min(Max, Value)): Max applied first, then Min, so Min wins if Min > Max.

extra.notes: any other key is one more operand; 'At least one Operand required'

And.notes: Logical AND of all operands (all evaluated, no short-circuit).

extra.notes: any other key is an operand; 'At least one Operand required'

Not.notes: !Value. Other key -> 'Only the field Value is expected.'

NonZero.notes: Value != 0. Other key -> 'Only the field Value is expected.'

Float2String.notes: Number formatted as text: grouping on, 0..3 fractional digits, HalfToEven (decompile shows AsCurrency_Float with those args; likely Conv_FloatToText) [inferred].

Values.notes: 'The field Values is required.' Parsed with MakeMutator(StringList): array, stringlist mutator, or a string (wrapped)

Join.notes: Joins the list with Sep. Other key -> 'Only the fields Values and Sep are expected.'

Lock.notes: exactly one of Lock / Update: '"Lock" or "Update" but not both must be set'. While Lock is true the output holds

Update.notes: output takes Value only on evaluations where Update is true

LockFloat.notes: Sample-and-hold: first evaluation always samples. Other key -> 'Unexpected field "{field}"'.

LockBoolean.notes: Same as LockFloat with a bool Value (exactly one of Lock/Update).

LockString.notes: Same as LockFloat with a string Value.

Value.notes: the input. Conventionally 'Value', but ANY key name not reserved is accepted as the input (first such key); a second one -> 'Unexpected field'. Missing -> 'Input Value must be set'

TriggerOnce.notes: Passes the input through only during its first true period (count of rising edges <= 1).

N.notes: 'N must be set'; truncated to int

TriggerNTimes.notes: Input passes through for its first N true periods.

N.notes: cooldown seconds; '"N" seconds must be set.'

TriggerCooldown.notes: Output = input && !cooldown; a falling edge of the input starts an N-second cooldown. Requires authority (server).

TriggerDelay.notes: Replays the input's rising/falling edges N seconds later. Requires authority.

Reset.notes: when true, a new rising edge while triggered restarts the N-second window

TriggerFixedDuration.notes: A rising edge of the input outputs true for exactly N seconds. Requires authority.

TriggerSustain.notes: Output = input, and stays true N seconds after the input falls. Requires authority.

TriggerSometimes.notes: On each rising edge rolls once; if it hits, passes the input through for that true period. Requires authority.

Value.notes: FLOAT input; any non-reserved key; 'Input Value must be set'

FallOnly.notes: 'RiseOnly and FallOnly are incompatible' when both keys are given

TriggerOnChange.notes: True on an evaluation where the float differs from the previous one (direction filtered by RiseOnly/FallOnly).

N.notes: period seconds; '"N" seconds must be set.'

Reset.notes: true holds the timer at N and outputs false

Enable.notes: inverse of Reset; "'Enable' and 'Reset' are mutually exclusive"

TriggerTimer.notes: No input. With Loop: true for one evaluation each time N seconds elapse. Without Loop: TimeRemaining is pinned at 0 after the first expiry, so it stays true until Reset (or Enable false). First evaluation only arms the timer. Requires authority.

Random.notes: New uniform roll in [Min, Max] on every evaluation (update interval <= 0.5 s). Requires authority.

RandomPerMission.notes: Deterministic per mission and per JSON location: stream seed = PLS seed XOR djb2(JSON path), mapped to [Min, Max]. Waits for the PLS.

Select.notes: '"Select" field must be set.' Its evaluated string is looked up among the option keys (TMap<FString>, case-insensitive)

Default.notes: used when no key matches; absent -> output 0/false/''

extra.notes: every other key is an option named by the key

Select.notes: Switch on a string. Requires authority.
index, rounded; '"Select" field must be set.'

Array.notes: '"Array" field must be set and non-empty.'; not an array -> 'Must Be An Array'

Default.notes: used when the rounded index is out of range; without it the index is clamped

Value.notes: not checked at load; if absent Select picks Else

Then.notes: not checked at load; absent -> output 0/false/'' when chosen

IfFloat.notes: Exactly one comparison key: 'A Comparison Operator Must Be Set' / 'Only One Comparison Operator Allowed'. Value <op> operand ? Then : Else.

Values.notes: per-player list, index = players-1 clamped (see values.per_player_array); not array -> "Field 'Values' must be an array"

ByPlayerCount.notes: Explicit form of the implicit per-player array. BUG/unclear: ConfigureMutator ends with Errors = {} so its own errors (unexpected field, non-array Values, bad elements) appear to be DROPPED; missing Values is not checked (empty options -> invalid pick). Waits for the PLS.

Choices.notes: not checked for presence/emptiness; not an array -> 'Must Be An Array'

Weights.notes: if given, count must equal Choices: 'Number of Choices and Weights Must Match'; negative weights count as 0

RandomChoice.notes: Re-rolls on every evaluation (update interval <= 1 s), uniform or weighted. Requires authority.

RandomChoicePerMission.notes: Same as RandomChoice but the stream is seeded with the PLS seed (one pick per mission; it computes a per-path Salt but the Select code seeds with the PLS seed only, so two RandomChoicePerMission with equal choices pick the same index [unclear if Salt is used]). Waits for the PLS; no authority needed.

Default.notes: required unless >= 9 distinct biomes are set: 'Default Must be set unless all biomes are specified' (then CrystalCaves' option is the fallback)

extra.notes: option per biome key. Aliases: CrystallineCaverns=CrystalCaves, GlacialStrata=IceCaves, MagmaCore=MagmaCaves, Sandblasted=SandblastedCorridors, RadioactiveExclusionZone/REZ=RadioactiveZone, SaltPits=SaltCaves, Biozone/DenseBiozone=LushDownpour. Unknown key -> "Unrecognized Biome '{key}'"

ByBiome.notes: Matches the PLS Biome object name (BIOME_*).

Default.notes: required unless all 9 types are set: "Either Provide a 'Default' or set all mission types" (then Mining is the fallback)

extra.notes: Egg=GM_EggCollection, PE=GM_Motherlode (point extraction), Sabotage=GM_Facility, DeepScan=GM_DeepScan. Other key -> 'Unexpected field "{field}"'

ByMissionType.notes: Keyed on the game mode class. Requires authority.

Dump.notes: value ignored; logs every Objective class name (error level) to help find keys

extra.notes: objective class names; the '_C' suffix is optional (both 'X' and 'X_C' accepted). Unknown -> 'Unrecognized Secondary "{field}"'. First key (map order) whose objective is among the mission's secondary objectives wins

BySecondary.notes: Waits for the PLS. Requires authority.

extra.notes: key = 'type[,length[,complexity]]', comma separated, trimmed, case-insensitive. type in egg|elimination|escort|mining|pe|refinery|sabotage|salvage|deepscan|x; length and complexity in 1..3 or x (x = any; omitted parts = x); 4+ parts invalid -> 'Invalid Mission DNA: {dna}'. Lookup order: t,l,c; t,l,x; t,x,c; x,l,c; t,x,x; x,l,x; x,x,c; then Default (x,x,x is never looked up)

ByDNA.notes: Length/complexity = mission DNA NumberOfDots. Requires authority.

Values.notes: exactly 3 elements: 'Values must be a list with 3 elements' / 'Values must be a list' / 'The field Values must be set'. Key compared case-SENSITIVELY (EqualEqual_StrStr)

ByMissionComplexity.notes: Index = complexity dots - 1. Other key -> 'Only the field Values is expected.' Requires authority.

Default.notes: "'Default' Value must be set"; used outside deep dives and for unset stages

Stage3.notes: BUG: parsed but never used: on stage 3 Select returns Stage2 (or Default)

ByDDStage.notes: Deep dive (normal or elite) stage by CurrentMissionIndex. Requires authority.

extra.notes: CD2_EEscort_State user-friendly names [names from the decompiled enum; display names assumed equal]. Unknown -> 'Unrecognized Escort State {es}'

ByEscortPhase.notes: State from CD2_Escort_Monitor; no valid state -> Default. Requires authority.

Default.notes: fallback key (checked before the enum value of the same name)

ByRefineryPhase.notes: Same code as ByEscortPhase over CD2_Refinery_Monitor.

BySaboPhase.notes: Same code as ByEscortPhase over CD2_Sabo_Monitor.

extra.notes: Mules: mules not all repaired; Uplink/Refuel: that drop-pod event actor exists with Progress < 1; else by PointsRepaired 0=PreUplink, 1=PreRefuel, other=Finished. Unset state -> Default; unknown key -> 'Unrecognized Salvage State {es}'

BySalvagePhase.notes: Primary objective must be OBJ_1st_Salvage, else Default. Requires authority.

IfOnSpaceRig.notes: Then on the space rig, Else in a mission.
